hospital.name: Trinethra Multi Speciality & Critical Care Center
hospital.slogan: Your Trusted Healthcare Destination in Jangareddygudem
hospital.description: Trinethra Multi Speciality & Critical Care Center provides 24/7 state-of-the-art critical care, emergency trauma management, general surgery, pediatrics, gynaecology, and ENT specialist care in Jangareddygudem with experienced doctors and round-the-clock ICU monitoring.

timings.opd: Mon - Sat: 9:30 AM - 8:30 PM | Sun: Emergency On-Call

about.mission: To deliver patient-first, ethical, and advanced clinical care to the community of Jangareddygudem and surrounding areas with 24/7 emergency readiness, state-of-the-art ICU facilities, and compassionate doctors.
about.vision: To be the most trusted multispeciality and critical care hospital in the region, recognized for immediate life-saving care, clinical integrity, and comprehensive medical specialties.

values.title: 24/7 Emergency & ICU Readiness
values.desc: Round-the-clock casualty team and mechanical ventilator support for immediate critical resuscitation.

values.title: Dedicated Medical Specialists
values.desc: Experienced consultants in Pediatrics, General Medicine, Laparoscopic Surgery, Gynaecology, and ENT.

values.title: In-House Diagnostics & Pharmacy
values.desc: On-site 24/7 diagnostic laboratory and hospital pharmacy for fast turnaround medication dispensing.

values.title: Transparent & Affordable Healthcare
values.desc: Ethical medical guidance, clean inpatient facilities, and supportive patient nursing care.

services.title: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
services.description: State-of-the-art ICU with continuous multiparameter monitoring, ventilators, central oxygen, and dedicated critical care nursing team.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency & Casualty
services.description: Rapid triage, emergency trauma resuscitation, acute medical stabilization, and immediate physician availability round-the-clock.

services.title: Pediatric & Child Health
services.description: Comprehensive child health, treatment for pediatric fevers, routine immunizations, and newborn care led by Dr. Nagendra Babu Garu (MBBS, DNB).

services.title: General & Laparoscopic Surgery
services.description: Laparoscopic procedures, emergency trauma surgery, hernia, appendicitis, and wound management led by Dr. P. Sarathy (M.B.B.S., M.S).

services.title: Obstetrics & Gynecology
services.description: Antenatal pregnancy care, high-risk maternity care, women's wellness, and fertility counseling under Dr. Priyanka (Gynaecologist).

services.title: ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat)
services.description: Specialized diagnosis and treatment for acute tonsillitis, chronic sinusitis, ear discharge, hearing, and vertigo by Dr. Samatha Garu.

services.title: 24/7 Hospital Pharmacy
services.description: Fully stocked hospital pharmacy providing verified medicines, pediatric formulations, and emergency injectables 24 hours a day.

services.title: Diagnostic & Pathology Lab
services.description: Complete blood counts, biochemistry, infectious panels (Dengue, Typhoid, Malaria), and routine diagnostic profiling.

reviews.author: Ramesh Kumar V.
reviews.text: Excellent emergency treatment and prompt medical care in Jangareddygudem. The ICU facility and staff responsiveness were life-saving during our critical time. Highly recommended hospital.

reviews.author: Srinivas Rao K.
reviews.text: Dr. Valli Sri and Dr. Sarathy gave very caring treatment. The hospital is very clean and the 24/7 pharmacy is a big advantage for Jangareddygudem residents.

reviews.author: Lakshmi Narayana P.
reviews.text: Dr. Nagendra Babu Garu is very patient with children. His diagnosis for our child's viral fever was accurate and recovery was fast. Best pediatrician in the area.

reviews.author: Bhavani Prasad M.
reviews.text: Best multispeciality hospital with round the clock emergency services. Immediate attention given at midnight when we brought our patient. Very grateful to the entire medical team.
